summary: Phase 1 spine end-to-end test. Extended pytest suite for new Role schema (job_title/industry/technical_skills/soft_skills/success_criteria/common_challenges/difficulty_level), PATCH /api/roles, full Case lifecycle (seeded → GET/PATCH/approve→409 lock/reopen → 503 for regenerate/regenerate-section/generate) and cross-manager scope isolation. 20/20 backend tests passed. Playwright validated full UI flow: login (prefilled creds), dashboard (stat-roles/cases/approved + claude-status-pill='Awaiting key' + candidate-activity-empty), 6-step wizard with all step testids → create-role-success → role detail rendering with new vocabulary + claude-not-configured-warning, case detail page (title/sections/rubric, rubric weight 100%), approve → case-approved-celebration toast + reopen button + lock, reopen → approve visible again, logout, protected-route redirect for /dashboard and /cases/:id.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend code is clean: UUID ids, _id stripped via doc_strip, async I/O throughout, env-driven config, proper 401/404/409/503 status codes, scoping enforced on roles+cases by manager_id, Pydantic validation on Role/Case update.

PATCH /api/roles/{id} 'no-op when no updates' branch directly returns the result of get_role(role_id, manager) but does not validate the role exists for current manager — if the role belongs to another manager, a request with empty body would return 404 anyway via get_role, so behavior is correct. Verified by tests.
approve_case does not check if case status is already 'approved' before re-approving (no idempotency error). Currently it just overwrites approved_at. Minor: acceptable for Phase 1.
reopen_case allows reopening a case that's already draft (no-op). Acceptable but slightly noisy in event log.
Routes /cases/{case_id} dynamic path is declared after the static /cases/role/{role_id} which is good (no route ordering bug).
Frontend: token stored under 'encore.token' key in localStorage. Consider hardening protected route guard via interceptor for 401 responses (current redirect-on-mount works).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed roles & a Manager B account for isolation; test_encore_phase1.py also directly seeds a draft case via Mongo (using db.py + Case model) to exercise approve/patch/reopen without Claude.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 7 test classes covering Health, Auth, Roles (new schema), Case 503 paths, and CaseLifecycle (seeded case). Token is stored in localStorage['encore.token'] as a raw JWT string. Frontend testids verified: login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button (NOT login-email/login-submit), logout-button (in AppShell header), stat-roles/stat-cases/stat-approved, claude-status-pill, candidate-activity-empty, dashboard-new-role-button, step-job-title/step-industry/step-seniority-{id}/step-tech-input/step-tech-add/step-soft-input/step-soft-add/step-success-criteria/step-common-challenges/step-difficulty-{id}, create-role-next/create-role-submit/create-role-success, case-detail-page/case-title-section/case-sections-section/case-rubric-section/rubric-weight-total/case-approve-button/case-reopen-button/case-approved-celebration. To run pytest you must export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (e.g. from /app/frontend/.env) since the test deliberately fails fast without defaults.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — Phase 1 spine fully functional.
